preconditions.description: The number of settlements is between 1 and 100000.
The number of settlements affected by the Book of Evil is between 1 and the number of settlements.
The damage range of the Book of Evil is between 0 and n - 1.
Each affected settlement number is between 1 and n.
Each path connects two settlements between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: The graph formed by the paths is connected and has exactly n - 1 paths.

postconditions.description: The output is 0 if no settlement may contain the Book of Evil, otherwise it is the number of settlements that may contain the Book.
